SimpleProduct:14930.faq:
How will my order be printed?

Each library bag is printed on demand and blends seamlessly to the top quality polyester fabric.

How do I wash my Library Bag?

To keep your Library Bag looking great we recommend that you wash them using a cold wash cycle. They shouldn't be bleached or put into a tumble dryer, but you can use a dry warm iron on the reverse of the print to keep them wrinkle-free.

description.html:
With two sturdy handles, your little one will be able to bring loads of books home from school to read with you. Our library bags are constructed from a high-quality polyester material that withstands everyday use, so they last all year & beyond. Machine washable, the bags are easy to keep clean and fresh for years.

All of our personalised library bag designs are printed on-demand, directly to the durable polyester fabric, meaning that you're guaranteed a vivid design that lasts. The best part? They're printed in Australia & shipped to you fast. Personalise this library book bag with your child's name, class name or initials. With so many designs to choose from, there's something here for every little bookworm.

Please Note: Our Library Bags are now made from a white polyester fabric that gives your print a crisp and vivid finish and will last for years to come.

Library Bag size: 38cm wide x 38cm high x 8cm deep (15" x 15" x 3").

Please Note: Whatever you type in the personalisation fields will be what is printed, so please make sure to double check your spelling.
